caption:
You won the argument. Feel hollow? (1 Timothy 6:12)

“Fight the good fight of faith.” Its target isn’t a person to knock down — it’s faith held to the end. The word is also a race: the runner’s real rival is the voice inside that says “stop.”

You don’t fight to win something new. Christ gave Himself as a ransom for all (2:6). You fight on the side of the One who has already won.
